# `scenes`

Scene files are levels and rooms (`assets/scenes/*.scene.json`). The player starts with the project's start scene; scripts switch or add scenes. Requests apply at the start of the next Update, so every script sees either the old or the new scene, never half of each. Entities loaded from a scene belong to it; entities spawned at runtime survive a switch unless parented under a scene entity or, with "despawn_unless_persistent", not marked with `scenes.persist`.

```lua
function Goal.on_trigger_enter(self, other)
    if other:name() == "Player" then
        scenes.switch("level2")
    end
end
```

## `scenes`

Runtime scenes: switch levels, load and unload scenes additively.

### `scenes.switch`

```luau
function scenes.switch(scene: string): number
```

Replaces every loaded scene with `scene` (a name such as "level2", for `assets/scenes/level2.scene.json`, or an assets-relative path) at the start of the next Update. The file is validated first; on failure nothing changes. Returns the id the new scene instance will have.

### `scenes.load_additive`

```luau
function scenes.load_additive(scene: string): number
```

Loads `scene` next to the loaded ones (a room, a UI scene) at the start of the next Update. Returns its instance id for `scenes.unload`.

### `scenes.load`

```luau
function scenes.load(scene: string): number
```

Deprecated: use `load_additive`.

### `scenes.unload`

```luau
function scenes.unload(id: number)
```

Removes a loaded scene instance and its entities.

### `scenes.current`

```luau
function scenes.current(): string?
```

The path of the main scene (the last switch, or the start scene), or nil.

### `scenes.is_loaded`

```luau
function scenes.is_loaded(id: number): boolean
```

True while the scene instance `id` is loaded.

### `scenes.persist`

```luau
function scenes.persist(entity: Entity, keep: boolean?): boolean
```

Marks a runtime entity (spawned by a script, not loaded from a scene) to survive scene switches (`keep` false unmarks it). Returns false if the entity is gone.

### `scenes.set_runtime_entities`

```luau
function scenes.set_runtime_entities(mode: "keep_all" | "despawn_unless_persistent")
```

What a scene switch does with runtime entities: "keep_all" (the default: they all survive) or "despawn_unless_persistent" (recommended: only root entities marked with `scenes.persist` survive).
